
```{r}
library(WGCNA)
library(edgeR)
# Recommended for multi-threading WGCNA math operations
allowWGCNAThreads()
```


```{r}
# A. Obtain logCPM matrix (genes in rows, samples in columns)
logcpm <- cpm(dge.data, log = TRUE)

# B. Select top 5,000 most variable genes across samples
gene_vars <- apply(logcpm, 1, var)
top_genes <- names(sort(gene_vars, decreasing = TRUE)[1:5000])
filtered_matrix <- logcpm[top_genes, ]

# C. Transpose matrix (samples as rows, genes as columns)
datExpr <- t(filtered_matrix)

# D. Check for excessive missing values or zero-variance genes
gsg <- goodSamplesGenes(datExpr, verbose = 3)
if (!gsg$allOK) {
  datExpr <- datExpr[gsg$goodSamples, gsg$goodGenes]
}
```


```{r}
sampleTree <- hclust(dist(datExpr), method = "average")
plot(sampleTree, main = "Sample Clustering to Detect Outliers", sub="", xlab="")
```


```{r}
powers <- c(1:10, seq(12, 20, by = 2))
sft <- pickSoftThreshold(datExpr, powerVector = powers, verbose = 5)

# Plot Scale-Free Topology Fit Index vs Power
plot(sft$fitIndices[, 1], -sign(sft$fitIndices[, 3]) * sft$fitIndices[, 2],
     xlab = "Soft Threshold (power)", ylab = "Scale Free Topology Model Fit, signed R^2",
     type = "n", main = "Scale Independence")
text(sft$fitIndices[, 1], -sign(sft$fitIndices[, 3]) * sft$fitIndices[, 2],
     labels = powers, col = "red")
abline(h = 0.80, col = "blue") # Aim for the lowest power above this line
```

```{r}
# Replace 'power = 6' with the value identified in Step 4
net <- blockwiseModules(
  datExpr,
  power = 6,
  TOMType = "unsigned",            # "signed" or "unsigned" network
  minModuleSize = 30,              # Minimum genes per module
  remergeCutHeight = 0.25,         # Merge modules that are >75% similar
  numericLabels = TRUE,
  pamRespectsDendro = FALSE,
  saveTOMs = FALSE,
  verbose = 3
)

# Convert numerical module IDs into color names
moduleColors <- labels2colors(net$colors)

# Plot the module dendrogram
plotDendroAndColors(
  net$dendrograms[[1]], 
  moduleColors[net$blockGenes[[1]]],
  "Module Colors",
  dendroLabels = FALSE, 
  hang = 0.03,
  addGuide = TRUE, 
  guideHang = 0.05
)
```


```{r}
# Convert group vector to numeric/binary design matrix
traits <- model.matrix(~ 0 + dge.data$samples$group)
colnames(traits) <- levels(dge.data$samples$group)

# Recalculate Module Eigengenes
MEs <- moduleEigengenes(datExpr, moduleColors)$eigengenes
MEs <- orderMEs(MEs)

# Calculate Pearson correlation between Module Eigengenes & sample traits
moduleTraitCor <- cor(MEs, traits, use = "p")
moduleTraitPvalue <- corPvalueStudent(moduleTraitCor, nSamples = nrow(datExpr))

# Visualize with a Heatmap
labeledHeatmap(
  Matrix = moduleTraitCor,
  xLabels = colnames(traits),
  yLabels = names(MEs),
  ySymbols = names(MEs),
  colorLabels = FALSE,
  colors = blueWhiteRed(50),
  textMatrix = paste0(round(moduleTraitCor, 2), "\n(p = ", signif(moduleTraitPvalue, 1), ")"),
  setStdMargins = FALSE,
  cex.text = 0.7,
  zlim = c(-1, 1),
  main = "Module-Trait Relationships"
)
```

```{r}
# Calculate Module Membership (kME) for all genes
geneModuleMembership <- as.data.frame(cor(datExpr, MEs, use = "p"))
colnames(geneModuleMembership) <- paste0("kME_", names(MEs))

# Extract top 10 hub genes in the lightyellow module
lightyellow_kME <- geneModuleMembership[moduleColors == "lightyellow", "kME_MElightyellow", drop = FALSE]
top_lightyellow_hubs <- head(lightyellow_kME[order(-lightyellow_kME$kME_MElightyellow), , drop = FALSE], 10)

print(top_lightyellow_hubs)
```
